_meta.about: Execution-2 SharedBot presentation vectors. Human-only sorting/read/compose cases retained; Bot identity, author and card fixtures replaced for the new contract. Avatar-only fixtures continue to test independent personal avatar rendering.

encoding.instants: ISO-8601 UTC strings or epoch milliseconds (field name ends in Ms).
encoding.conversations[].at: absent = conversation has no lastMessage pointer; null = pointer whose server timestamp is not stamped yet; string = lastMessage.at. The pointer used by the list tests is {id:"m"+id, seq:lastSeq, at, author:{kind:"user",uid:"u2"}, preview:"hi"}.
encoding.labels[].conversation / previews: {id} refers to conversations[]; otherwise a full inline conversation. zh=true selects strings.zh, false strings.en.
encoding.lastMessage[].input: {"$ts": ISO} stands for a Firestore Timestamp; {"$absent": true} means the field is not present in the document at all (differs from an explicit null).
encoding.listTimeKinds / dayLabelKinds: classification only; each platform formats the string with its own date APIs (see section 8.2).
encoding.\"<unit>×<N>\": N repetitions of the single code point before the multiplication sign (kept short in the file); expand before use.
encoding.compose.*: indices (caret, start) are UTF-16 code-unit offsets, as in JavaScript; snippet counts Unicode code points; byteLength is UTF-8 bytes.
